claims.statement: Malicious anthropic.claude-code versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 were served from Cursor Marketplace during a limited 29 October 2026 exposure window; official npm and Visual Studio Marketplace distribution were not affected.
Injected JavaScript attempted host reconnaissance, SSH key installation, local SSH enablement, reverse SSH forwarding, persistence and delayed host reporting.
The sources publish exact file hashes, filenames, persistence paths, an infrastructure IP, SSH-key context and reverse-forwarding command grammar.
Defender XDR documents the file, process and network fields used by the hunt.
Exact hashes and published infrastructure have higher campaign specificity than generic filenames or SSH grammar.
claims.confirm_or_refute: Measure benign prevalence and validate ownership, extension provenance and destination context for every condition.

claims.statement: Two independent evidence layers on one device materially strengthen the exposure assessment.
claims.confirm_or_refute: Use controlled file, process and network events to test whether legitimate workflows produce the same combinations.

claims.statement: Successful attacker access depended on privileges and SSH configuration; artifacts could be written even when tunnel access failed.
